{{Top|leg}}
'''Bantha hide''' was a substance made from [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] and used to make clothing and furniture. For example, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] owned a pair of bantha hide knee boots.<ref name="LRFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
